OnlineMatchRoom.title: Online Match Room
OnlineMatchRoom.description: Multiplayer match room containing player info, match status, score, timer, and rematch state

status.description: Current room state: waiting, selecting_country, starting, ready, playing, finished, opponent_left

gameMode.description: Match, penalty shootout, or division match mode

division.description: Division level tier for division matchmaking

currentKickerRole.description: Role of the active kicker (host or guest)

matchTime.description: Synchronized match time remaining in seconds

score.description: Live scoreboard host and guest points

host.description: Host player profile and country selection

guest.description: Guest player profile and country selection

isOpponentDisconnected.description: True if one peer has disconnected

isPublic.description: Whether room is listed in public rooms browser

maxPlayers.description: Maximum contenders for this room (e.g. 4 for KOTH)

players.description: All contenders currently in the room lobby or match

kothState.description: King of the Hill synchronized tournament state
